book.title: The Telegraph All New Cryptic Crosswords 4

clue.text: Interest shared about a point

indicators.note: the word for shared is placed around the point, so it sits about it

parts.note: something shared out has been divided among people
N, north, is one of the points of the compass

explanation.surface: Two parties split a financial stake over a disputed point.
explanation.definitionFit: A dividend is the share of company profits paid to holders, a return on an investment just as interest is.

clue.text: 'I'm lacking lustre in run through

parts.note: taken as written, without the apostrophe
pale means dull, wan, without shine

explanation.surface: Someone complains of looking dull and washed out while running through something.
explanation.definitionFit: To impale is to pierce with a pointed stake or spear, which is running something through.

clue.text: He doesn't do much to earn his description

definitions.meaning: the surface reads as a slacker who has done little to deserve a label
his description is the noun for a person who does nothing, a lazybones

explanation.walkthrough: The twist is that doing little is exactly what earns the label: the less he does, the better the word fits.
explanation.definitionFit: An idler is a person who avoids work and lazes about, so inactivity is the whole qualification.

clue.text: When alone, gets changed and stretches out

indicators.note: the letters of alone and gets are changed into a fresh order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone left alone changes into comfortable clothes and sprawls out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets changed' reads as dressing; 'gets' is part of the fodder and 'changed' alone is the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To elongate is to make longer, which is what stretching something out does.

clue.text: Very keen supporter voted out on two points

indicators.note: out means wrong or disordered, so the letters of voted with two points are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, the word whose letters are rearranged
E, east, taken twice from the compass points

explanation.surface: A passionate backer is voted out of office on two counts.
explanation.definitionFit: A devotee is an ardent follower or enthusiast, wholly given over to the cause.

clue.text: It is weighed by a craftsman

definitions.meaning: the surface suggests something put on scales; the nautical phrase is to weigh this, meaning to raise it
read as craft's man: a man of a craft, a ship, so a sailor

explanation.walkthrough: 'craftsman' looks like an artisan weighing materials; split it as craft's man, a sailor on a boat, who weighs (raises) the heavy hook before sailing.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailors weigh anchor when they haul it up from the seabed to get under way.

clue.text: Pole in wrong gear shows annoyance

indicators.note: the pole is placed in the shuffled letters of gear
the letters of gear are put together the wrong way

parts.note: taken as written, the word whose letters are rearranged
N, the North Pole

explanation.surface: A Polish man in unsuitable kit shows his irritation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole' looks like a nationality; it is a magnetic pole, N.
explanation.definitionFit: Anger is strong displeasure, a heightened form of annoyance.

clue.text: Victor takes girl endless celebratory wine

parts.note: a champ, short for champion, is a winner

indicators.note: the girl's name loses its final letter, its end

parts.note: Agnes is a girl's name

explanation.surface: The winner takes his girlfriend out for a celebratory drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Champagne is the sparkling wine traditionally opened to mark victories and celebrations.

clue.text: No hunter, but possibly hunted

indicators.note: possibly says the letters of no hunter could make something else

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Not the predator but perhaps the prey.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone on the run is fleeing pursuers, so is being hunted or chased.

clue.text: The sun-god shot off to the moon

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the Greek god of the sun, music and poetry
second meaning: the US space programme whose rockets carried astronauts to the moon

explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a deity heading for the moon; the name belongs both to the god and to NASA's lunar missions.
explanation.definitionFit: NASA named its moon-landing programme after the Greek deity who drove the sun's chariot across the sky.

clue.text: Beggars get state hand-outs

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia
grants are sums of money handed out

explanation.surface: People living on the street receive government handouts.
explanation.definitionFit: Vagrants are homeless wanderers who often live by begging.

clue.text: O.K., there's nothing left

definitions.meaning: first meaning: satisfactory, fine
second meaning, read literally: everything is right, so none of it is left

explanation.walkthrough: 'nothing left' looks like all used up; read it as left versus right, so all is right.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an everyday equivalent of okay, and taken word by word it says every bit is on the right.

clue.text: Gunners get support weapon

parts.note: RA, the Royal Artillery, the British army's gunners
a pier is a pillar that supports a bridge or arch

explanation.surface: Artillerymen are backed up with an extra weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A rapier is a slender, sharp-pointed sword used for thrusting.

clue.text: Where an actor eventually finds regular employment?

definitions.meaning: an actor's steady work is in a show that keeps running for months
the phrase meaning eventually or in the end

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase means ultimately, but an actor's best hope of steady work is a show with a lengthy run.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means over time or ultimately, and literally describes a play with many performances.

clue.text: Angry with daughter about dress getting wet

indicators.note: the word for angry goes around the word for dress

parts.note: irate means very angry
rig is clothing, an outfit

explanation.surface: Someone is cross with their daughter for getting her dress soaked.
explanation.definitionFit: Irrigated land has been supplied with water, so it has been watered or made damp.

clue.text: Start to make a speech without a single drink

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the speech word goes around the rest

parts.note: to orate is to speak formally in public
I, the Roman numeral one
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: A speaker begins addressing the room without so much as one drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking; here it means outside, wrapping the other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To originate is to begin or bring into being, so it means to start.

clue.text: The worst type of underground heating

definitions.meaning: the surface suggests a poor domestic heating system
the flames of hell, deep below ground in tradition

explanation.walkthrough: It reads like a complaint about a boiler, but the underground heat meant is the fire of the infernal regions.
explanation.definitionFit: Hellfire is the fire of the damned in hell, traditionally pictured beneath the earth.

clue.text: Dear Sir, these could be what you've always wanted

indicators.note: the letters of Dear Sir and these could be turned into another phrase

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A letter opening 'Dear Sir' promises the very things the reader has longed for.
explanation.definitionFit: Your heart's desire is the thing you most wish for, what you have always longed to have.

clue.text: They drew the line at nothing here

definitions.meaning: mapmakers drew this line round the globe
nothing is zero, the latitude where this line lies

explanation.walkthrough: 'drew the line at nothing' sounds like people with no limits; it means the line drawn at zero degrees latitude.
explanation.definitionFit: The equator is the circle of latitude 0°, the line on maps halfway between the poles.

clue.text: Article and new film about a resort in Italy

parts.note: a is the indefinite article

indicators.note: the reworked film goes around the second a
new means the letters of film take a new form

parts.note: taken as written, the word whose letters are rearranged
taken as written

explanation.surface: A news piece about a new film shot at an Italian holiday spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Amalfi is a town on the coast south of Naples, a popular holiday destination.

clue.text: Mixes up signal, gets in a row

indicators.note: mixes up tells you to jumble the letters of signal

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A soldier garbles a message and finds himself in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a row' suggests a quarrel; it means a straight line.
explanation.definitionFit: To align things is to put them in a straight line, one after another.

clue.text: Quick way to dry a step

parts.note: a way such as a street, written the quick way as its short form St
to air clothes is to dry them by exposing them

explanation.surface: A fast method for drying a doorstep.
explanation.definitionFit: A stair is a single step in a flight of steps.

clue.text: Prepared to protest strongly, well informed about weapons

parts.note: to be up in a subject is to be knowledgeable about it
arms are weapons

explanation.surface: Someone versed in weaponry is ready to make a fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: Being up in arms means angrily protesting, as if ready to take up weapons.

clue.text: A short spell of hostile behaviour

definitions.meaning: spell means a way of writing a word, here a shortened, slangy version
the long word for hostile behaviour is aggravation or aggression

explanation.walkthrough: 'spell' looks like a brief period of time; it is a word's spelling, and the answer is the clipped slang form of aggravation.
explanation.definitionFit: Aggro is British slang, clipped from aggravation, for trouble, violence or deliberate provocation.

clue.text: Absent-minded girl's distinguishing feature

parts.note: Di, short for Diana, a girl's name, with the possessive s
a trait is a characteristic quality

explanation.surface: A young woman's defining quality is her forgetfulness.
explanation.definitionFit: Distrait, borrowed from French, means distracted or preoccupied, with attention elsewhere.

clue.text: High spirits?

definitions.meaning: the surface suggests cheerfulness; read it as up in the sky or heaven
heavenly beings, not moods or drinks

explanation.walkthrough: 'High spirits' is the phrase for elation; the question mark says to take it literally as beings dwelling on high.
explanation.definitionFit: Angels are spiritual beings thought to live in heaven, above us.

clue.text: One who cares is easily hurt

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a person who tends or looks after something, as a nurse or keeper does
second meaning: sore, sensitive to pain

explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a carer being sensitive; the two halves are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: A tender is one who tends or looks after something, and a tender spot is painful and sensitive.

clue.text: Rich language changed to richer

indicators.note: the letters of to richer are changed into another word

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Flowery speech has been revised to make it even more ornate.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhetoric is persuasive, often elaborate or showy speech, language rich in effect.
